steps: Choose the Test checklist tab, last in the row
items.expect: A line such as '0 of 180 tested · 0 broken · 0 need work', then the items grouped under area headings, each with steps and 'You should see'.
Setup opens on the Test checklist tab.

items.feature: A result and a note are kept
steps: Close the companion and start it again
items.expect: The item still reads Broken with your note, and the top line counts it as tested and broken.

steps: Mark one item Broken and one Needs work
Press Broken in the filter row, then Needs work, then Untested
items.expect: Each filter shows only its items and its count; All shows everything again. Retest lists items recorded on an earlier build.

steps: Press Copy results and paste into a text editor
Press Export… and save the file
items.expect: Markdown with the build, the time in your clock, a summary, then Broken and Needs work items with notes and steps, then Untested, Works and Skipped. The saved .md file holds the same text.

steps: Press Clear results again, then Clear all
items.expect: Keep them changes nothing. Clear all puts every item back to untested with no notes, and the top line reads 0 tested.
